ability.name: Khainite Pendant
ability.effect: Give that unit D6 ritual points.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Crown of Woe
ability.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 9" of this unit.

ability.name: Sevenfold Shadow
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
